name: Angelamaria Fede
bioAdditions: Angelamaria's FamilySearch profile (LCXQ-84D) carries three indexed Avellino records, including the 1867 marriage (6J4L-ZFYB) and a record grouped with Savino (89S6-17N2). It names her parents as Bartolomeo Fede and Nunzianna Roberto (married 10 Jul 1835) (S1). The child profiles give her children as Francesco (1869), Lucia (1872), Antonio (1874–1903), Lucia (1877–1878), Maria Giuseppa (1880), Nunzianda (c.1885–1888) and Bartolomeo (1889). If her c.1849 birth is right, her last child was born when she was about 40 (S1, S2).
